title: test(server): increase test coverage for GitService
body:
Test coverage was very low for GitService. This adds integration tests simulating real git commands that operate on local and bare repositories. Tests cover cloning, worktree creation/deletion, checking out branches, committing changes, evaluating differences, and resolving push capabilities.
